body:
Good morning!

Today we fill the cellar. I've written a list of everything we need, and I'd love you to read it for me while I see to the hens.

Come when you're ready. The kettle is on!
summary: Read Mrs. Hannah's list and fill the winter cellar.
done: The cellar is full for the winter!

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (take the map)
at the coop by your house
